> [!IMPORTANT]
> **One-Time Reinstall Required**: This release transitions to our official stable signing key for seamless future auto-updates. Because past builds were signed with ephemeral keys, you must perform a one-time manual reinstall:
> 1. Back up your library first (**Settings → Backup and Restore**).
> 2. Uninstall your current Ozone Player app.
> 3. Install this new APK. All future updates will update in place automatically!
